name: Vishnuteja Ambati
tagline: Computer Engineering at Iowa State · AI systems, research & real-time engineering

intro.headline: Engineer. Researcher. Professional problem-hunter.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Vishnu. I'm a Computer Engineering student at Iowa State University, having started at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad, and I build AI systems that have to work outside the notebook: knowledge graphs for investors, behavior recognition that runs on a laptop CPU, and adversarial-ML research where physics keeps the attacker honest.
I like hard problems, honest numbers, and software that survives contact with reality.
